camera.orientation: camera is above +Z and looks straight down -Z; head/forward +X projects toward token top; tail/rear projects toward token bottom
camera.framing: fixed scale with ground origin at token [50,48]
camera.depthOrder: far-to-near camera depth; higher +Z surfaces render nearer; stable semantic-id tie break

idleA.motionSemantics: four fixed paws, quiet low breathing/sniffing, round ear movement and a long low tail sway; adapted from NeutralStand rather than the native rearing Idle

walkA.motionSemantics: baked sagittal IK; shoulder/hip swing, elbow/stifle flexion, opposing hind hock; planted stance and raised swing

attack.motionSemantics: authored braced bite: jaw opening, short forward snout/body thrust, fast closure, release and complete recovery over four fixed paws; no attack exists in the native Rat action library

run.motionSemantics: fast alternating diagonal foot pairs, short low recovery and continuous ground support; no exaggerated body bound

idle.motionSemantics: four fixed paws, quiet low breathing/sniffing, round ear movement and a long low tail sway; adapted from NeutralStand rather than the native rearing Idle

walk.motionSemantics: baked sagittal IK; shoulder/hip swing, elbow/stifle flexion, opposing hind hock; planted stance and raised swing

profile.silhouette: small low rat: arched rounded rump, tapering chest, pointed wedge muzzle, round ears, short folded limbs, broad tiny paws and a long thin tapering tail
profile.locomotion: rapid four-beat scurry; faster alternating footwork with continuous ground support and a low steady back
profile.attack: authored braced bite: crouch and jaw opening, short neck/body thrust, sudden jaw closure and recovery; native source has no attack action
